intro: My creative work began on the radio in Lagos, Nigeria. I learned to write for an audience and tell stories through voice and sound.
At the University of Lagos, I studied Advertising and Film and directed a student documentary and a short film.
I also co-founded Addict Creative, a creative agency that focuses on brand and motion design. We have worked with multiple brands in different capacities, including Electronic Arts.

pieces.title: The Apa Kingdom
pieces.subtitle: An expository documentary on the Apa Kingdom
pieces.body: A portrait of a community's cultural traditions, told through location footage and interviews with its king and chiefs.

poster.alt: A man in a white tunic speaking to camera in front of a pink building in Badagry, a still from the documentary

pieces.title: Capella AI
pieces.subtitle: Promo video
pieces.body: A motion-led introduction to a trading education platform, presenting guided lessons, AI mentorship and interactive simulations.
pieces.caption: Luminous type and layered imagery establish a digital visual world.

poster.alt: Floating video panels glowing against a dark blue field, a still from the Capella AI promo

pieces.title: Guidely
pieces.subtitle: Explainer video
pieces.body: An introduction to a brand that makes AI more approachable for beginners.
pieces.caption: Illustrated everyday scenes give an abstract subject a human presence.

poster.alt: Flat illustrated figures at desks in lilac, blue and grey panels, a still from the Guidely explainer

pieces.title: Virtual.co
pieces.subtitle: Promo video
pieces.body: A fast-paced promotional piece built around typography and the offer of hiring video editors.
pieces.caption: Portraits, bold lettering and shifts in scale give the sequence its energy.

poster.alt: Portrait tiles and bold lettering on a cream background, a still from the Virtual.co promo
